newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,043 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,043 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,043 contracts compared with 834 overnight Monday.
There were 66 wheat, 584 corn, 306 soybean, four soymeal, three soyoil, six corn calls and 74 soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one cent lower to 1-3/4 cents higher, corn was steady to 1/4 cent lower and soybeans were steady to one cent lower.
